title: The Monarchy of the North
summary: Monarchists led by Paiva Couceiro proclaimed the restoration of the monarchy in Porto on 19 January 1919 and held the north for about a month before republican forces retook the city in mid-February. A parallel rising in Lisbon failed within days.
